lines.en: Rachel, what is your cat doing in one of my bowls?
It's not. I'm defrosting a chicken.
Did you get your money back?
I just came for the red velvet pillow.
And, uh, don't forget, you can come visit her anytime you want.
Oh, good, great. I'll keep that in mind.
Hey, so what is this, some kind of snake or something?
